title: Watching Watergate hearings at the Gold Key Motel as F. Lee Bailey makes a pay-phone call
summary: Dan Sheehan tells of Watching Watergate hearings at the Gold Key Motel as F. Lee Bailey makes a pay-phone call, about 1973 at Washington, D.C., and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: I was sitting in the goldkey motel mhm with my investigator the William Johnstone Taylor

plain: Dan Sheehan, a lawyer described on Jesse Michels's podcast as involved in many famous American cases, says that in 1973 he sat in the Gold Key Motel in Washington with his investigator, William Johnstone Taylor, watching the Watergate hearings, the Senate hearings into the scandal around President Nixon. He says that while they watched, the well-known lawyer F. Lee Bailey made a call from a pay phone, and he ties this scene to others in the case such as Gerald Alch and Senators Daniel Inouye and Sam Ervin.
